{{Quote|Before Arcann's betrayal, Zakuul was protected by two orders: the Knights, and Scions who see visions of the past and future.''"<br />"''Fate is a tale whispered to us by the Force. But the voices are silent about you. We must know why.|Senya Tirall and Heskal|<ref name="Chapter 6" />}}
The '''Scions of Zakuul''', commonly known simply as the '''Scions''', was a division of the [[Knights of Zakuul]] who possessed the [[Force vision/Legends|ability to see the future]] through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and were infatuated with the idea of destiny.<ref name="Codex" /> They believed in their visions to the point of fanaticism, as opposed to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], who believe that the future is constantly in motion and only comes in pieces.

==History==
[[File:Heskal_reveals_a_secret.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Heskal reveals that Valkorion still lives within the Outlander's mind.]]
Early in his reign over the [[Eternal Empire]], [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]] developed the Scions within the Knights and used their visions to locate the dormant [[Eternal Fleet]].<ref name="Fleet">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|Eternal Fleet}}</ref> Scions were often paired with standard Knights to form a team with both physical and mental prowess, but after Valkorion's son [[Arcann]]&mdash;who detested the Scions&mdash;became Emperor, he ordered the mass slaughter of the Scions, nearly wiping them out.<ref name="Codex" /> [[Heskal]] and a group of Scions were among those who survived, and they took refuge on [[Asylum]] until they aided [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]]. The Scions put the Outlander through a series of combat tests and questioned their intentions before ultimately learning that Valkorion had survived within the Outlander's mind.<ref name="Chapter 6" /> However, Heskal later killed most of his group after they discovered he had summoned Arcann to Asylum in order to fulfill his vision; nonetheless, the remaining Scions remained loyal to the Outlander and planned to aid the Outlander's [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] when it was necessary.<ref name="Chapter 8">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=8}}</ref>

The Scions would only reappear on the world of [[Iokath]], helping the Outlander defeat the machine god [[Tyth]].<ref name="TOR" /> Several of them also joined the [[Order of Zildrog]] against the Alliance. After the Outlander defeated the Order, the Scions offered their apologies for the actions of their rogue comrades.

During the events of the [[third Galactic War]], the Scions, lead by [[Minazar]], had enacted upon Heskal's prophecy, and sough to resurrect Valkorion. They had managed to track down [[Kira Carsen's ship]] and arrived via a [[Eternal Empire shuttle|Zakuulan shuttle]]. However, the ship had already been uncovered by the rogue Sith group the Servants, fanatical remnants of the [[Hand of the Empire|Emperor's Hand]]. The two conflicting parties, serving the same Emperor but having differing views as to his will, broke out into [[Mission to Kira Carsen's ship|conflict]] aboard the vessel, with the Scions being overpowered by the Servants. By the time [[Task Force Nova]] had arrived, Minazar died at the hands of [[Servant Four]], and the remaining Scions were wiped out never to be seen on the face of the galaxy again. In the end, the Scions joined their master and faded into oblivion.
